title: Amadosiye Wakuyemo Abikwa He? Amabwiriza ya Android na iPhone
description: Ntubona dosiye wakuyemo? Menya aho amadosiye abikwa kuri Android, iPhone, iPad na mudasobwa, n'uko wimurira videwo muri Gallery cyangwa Photos.
photoCaption: Aho amadosiye abikwa kuri Android na iPhone si hamwe.
photo2Caption: Kuri mudasobwa, amadosiye ajya mu bubiko bwa Downloads.
body:
Wamaze gukanda buto yo gukuramo, ariko ntubona videwo muri Gallery? Humura, ni ikibazo gikunze kubaho cyane. Akenshi dosiye iba yamaze kubikwa, ariko iri mu bundi bubiko butari ubwo watekerezaga. Iyi mfashanyigisho isobanura aho amadosiye wakuyemo abikwa kuri Android, iPhone, iPad na mudasobwa, hamwe n'uko wayimura kugira ngo uyafungure byoroshye.

Ibisobanuro biri hasi bireba amadosiye wakuyemo ukoresheje mushakisha, harimo videwo, amajwi n'amafoto bivuye kuri I Need Save. Amadosiye yoherezwa ako kanya avuye ku rubuga rw'umwimerere ajya ku gikoresho cyawe kandi ntabikwa kuri seriveri ya I Need Save, bityo kopi yonyine iri kuri telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa yawe.

Aho Amadosiye Wakuyemo Abikwa kuri Android

Kuri Android, amadosiye ukuye muri mushakisha ajya mu bubiko bwa Downloads. Dore uko wabufungura:

  1. Fungura app icunga amadosiye yazanye na telefoni. Izina ryayo ritandukana bitewe n'ikirango cya telefoni, urugero My Files, Files cyangwa File Manager.
  2. Hitamo Downloads.
  3. Tondeka ukurikije itariki iheruka kugira ngo amadosiye mashya aze hejuru.
  4. Kanda kuri dosiye kugira ngo uyikine, cyangwa uyikandeho igihe kirekire kugira ngo uyimure, uhindure izina ryayo cyangwa uyisangize.

Hari ubundi buryo bwihuse: fungura menu ya mushakisha, maze uhitemo igice cy'ibyakuweho (downloads). Aho uhasanga urutonde rw'amadosiye umaze kubika, kandi ushobora kuyafungura uhereye aho.

Kuki videwo itaragaragara muri Gallery?

App ya Gallery rimwe na rimwe ifata akanya gato kugira ngo isuzume amadosiye mashya. Niba videwo itaragaragara, tegereza gato, hanyuma ufunge app ya Gallery wongere uyifungure. Kuri telefoni zimwe, videwo ziri mu bubiko bwa Download zigaragara muri alubumu yihariye yitwa Download cyangwa Downloads, bityo reba no ku rutonde rwa alubumu.

Aho Amadosiye Wakuyemo Abikwa kuri iPhone na iPad

Kuri iPhone na iPad, amadosiye ukuye muri Safari ntajya ako kanya muri app ya Photos. Abikwa muri app ya Files, mu bubiko bwa Downloads.

Kugira ngo ushobore kureba videwo muri app ya Photos, kurikiza izi ntambwe:

  1. Fungura app ya Files.
  2. Injira mu bubiko bwa Downloads.
  3. Kanda kuri videwo ushaka kwimura kugeza ifunguye.
  4. Kanda buto ya Share (Sangiza).
  5. Hitamo Save Video.

Nyuma yaho, videwo izagaragara muri app ya Photos hamwe n'izindi videwo. Ku mafoto, intambwe zirasa: fungura ifoto muri Files, ukande Share, hanyuma uhitemo uburyo bwo kubika ifoto.

Videwo imaze kubikwa muri Photos, ushobora gusiba kopi iri mu bubiko bwa Downloads kugira ngo ububiko bwa iPhone yawe bugume bufite umwanya.

Aho Amadosiye Wakuyemo Abikwa kuri Mudasobwa

Haba kuri Windows cyangwa kuri Mac, amadosiye mushakisha ikuramo akenshi ajya mu bubiko bwa Downloads.

  • Windows: fungura File Explorer, hanyuma ukande Downloads mu ruhande rw'ibumoso.
  • Mac: fungura Finder, hanyuma uhitemo Downloads mu ruhande rw'ibumoso.
  • Uhereye muri mushakisha: fungura urutonde rw'ibyakuweho muri mushakisha. Muri Chrome kuri Windows, urugero, ushobora gukanda Ctrl+J.

Niba warigeze guhindura igenamiterere rya mushakisha kugira ngo amadosiye abikwe mu bundi bubiko, reba ubwo bubiko unyuze mu igenamiterere ryo gukuramo rya mushakisha yawe.

Amadosiye y'Amajwi n'Amafoto Abikwa He?

Abikwa aho videwo zibikwa. Amajwi, yaba ay'ubwiza bw'umwimerere cyangwa MP3 ya 192 kbps ihinduwe ivuye muri videwo, ajya mu bubiko bwa Downloads. Ni na ko bimeze ku mafoto n'amafoto mato. Kuri Android, dosiye za MP3 akenshi zishobora gukinwa ukoresheje app icunga amadosiye cyangwa app y'umuziki. Kuri iPhone, dosiye z'amajwi zishobora gukinwa ako kanya muri app ya Files.

Niba ushaka kumenya uko wakura amajwi muri videwo, soma amabwiriza uko wahindura videwo zo ku mbuga nkoranyambaga MP3.

Nta Dosiye na Mba? Reba Ibi

  • Gukuramo ntibirarangira. Videwo zimwe zibanza gutunganywa, kandi buto izandikaho Birimo gutegurwa…. Tegereza kugeza gukuramo bitangiye ubwabyo, kandi ntufunge urupapuro vuba cyane.
  • Ububiko bwuzuye. Niba umwanya wenda gushira, gukuramo bishobora kwanga. Bohora umwanya muto hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
  • Ibikubiyemo ntibishobora gukurwamo. Ibikubiyemo byihariye, ibisaba kwinjira, cyangwa ibyabujijwe mu turere tumwe ntibishobora kubikwa.

Niba wabonye dosiye ariko ikanga gukina, reba ibisubizo mu nyandiko videwo wakuyemo yanga gukina.

Icya nyuma: bika ibikubiyemo ugamije kubikoresha ku giti cyawe gusa kandi wubahe uburenganzira bw'abahanzi. Niba ushaka kubyongera gushyira ku rubuga, banza usabe uruhushya kandi uvuge izina rya nyirabyo.

Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa

Ese aho amadosiye wakuyemo abikwa hashobora guhindurwa?

Kuri mudasobwa, mushakisha nyinshi zikwemerera guhitamo ububiko bwo gukuriramo mu igenamiterere. Kuri telefoni, biterwa na mushakisha na sisitemu ukoresha.

Kuki kuri iPhone videwo idahita ijya muri Photos?

Safari ibika amadosiye yakuwemo muri app ya Files. Ugomba gufungura videwo muri Files, ukande Share, hanyuma uhitemo Save Video.

Ese amadosiye yanjye abikwa kuri seriveri ya I Need Save?

Oya. Amadosiye yoherezwa ako kanya avuye ku rubuga rw'umwimerere ajya ku gikoresho cyawe, bityo bika neza amadosiye y'ingenzi.
